subtitle.message: A little order for your chats

menuLayout.message: Click to open a small menu

step1.message: Select the checkboxes beside your chats.

step2.message: Use the menu beside Chats to clear, invert or select all.

step3.message: Choose Delete, review and confirm once. Processing runs in the background.

scope.message: Select all and invert affect only chats currently loaded in the sidebar. Scroll to load more. Refreshing clears your selection.

privacy.message: Runs only on ChatGPT. Stores settings only, not chats or credentials. No data is sent to third parties.

warning.message: ChatGPT will delete these $N$ chats. This cannot be undone.

failed.message: Completed $N$. The request failed; remaining selections were kept.

stopped.message: Stopped after $N$. Deletions already sent cannot be undone.

refresh.message: Refresh ChatGPT after installing or updating the extension.

working.message: Deleting in the background. You can continue using the page.

apiError.message: Check your login or retry later. Refresh to verify uncertain results.

concurrencyHelp.message: Default 2; not an official limit. Rate limits stop the batch and reduce concurrency to 1.

modeHint.message: When hidden, move to the left edge to reveal.

extensionDescription.message: Select and bulk delete ChatGPT chats from the sidebar. Available in six languages.
